logp.method_description: An aliquot of either [99mTc][TcOL1] or [99mTc][TcOL2] (50 μL) was added to a partition of 1-octanol (5 mL) that had been presaturated with PBS and PBS (5 mL, pH 7.4) that had been presaturated with 1-octanol. The mixture was vortexed for 2 min, centrifuged (14000 rpm) for 5 min, and then allowed to stand for 15 min to ensure complete separation of the layers. A 500 μL aliquot of the 1-octanol layer was then repartitioned with fresh PBS (500 μL). The mixture was vortexed for 2 min, centrifuged (14000 rpm) for 5 min, and then allowed to stand for 15 min. A 100 μL aliquot of each layer was taken for γ counting on a Wallac 1282 Compugamma CS universal gamma counter. Each partition was repeated in triplicate.
